ielts.note: English-taught bachelor programmes need English level B2 or above (about IELTS 5.5); Italian-taught programmes need Italian B2. A specific IELTS score is not set.

requirement.text: Secondary school diploma after at least 12 years of schooling (plus the national entrance exam certificate, where your country requires one); English B2 or above for English-taught programmes; the TIL admission test or a SAT score (SAT not valid for Architecture). Non-EU applicants abroad pre-enrol on Universitaly (2026/27 round: language certificate by 22 May, pre-enrolment about 30 June).
